events.address: The BLANC NYC, 15 E 40th St, New York, NY 10016
events.what_it_is: ASICS' public SportStyle shop near Grand Central, featuring SportStyle collections, exclusive in-store styles and a complimentary shoe-charm customization bar.
events.what_is_free: Entry is free and the shop advertises a complimentary charm bar; retail merchandise is sold separately.
events.caveats: ASICS' official page currently says the shop is open through September 15 from 10 AM–7 PM at 15 E 40th Street. The complimentary charm bar is part of the experience; no guarantee of specific charm inventory is stated.
events.practical_notes: Open Monday, September 14 and Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–7 PM. No RSVP or approval requirement is published.

events.event_name: National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: LaGuardia Pl between W 4th St and W 3rd St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: HeadCount's nonpartisan National Voter Registration Day block party beside Washington Square Park with live music, art, brand activations and voter-registration activity.
events.what_is_free: Current event listings advertise free public admission, brand freebies and chocolate; exact promotional inventory is not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM. BroadwayWorld gives the more specific street location on LaGuardia Place between W 4th and W 3rd; NYC for FREE summarizes it as Washington Square Park. No RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM beside Washington Square Park. Walk in; promotional freebies are subject to available inventory.

events.address: Multiple NYC Insomnia Cookies bakeries; use official PJ Party locator
events.what_it_is: Insomnia Cookies' eighth annual PJ Party, with the core free-cookie offer running at every U.S. and Canada bakery and additional merch/giveaways at select locations.
events.what_is_free: Wear pajamas to a participating bakery and receive one free Classic cookie in store. Select bakeries also advertise free merch and giveaways while supplies last.
events.caveats: The free Classic cookie requires arriving in pajamas and is in-store only. Most bakeries run the party from 8 PM until close; closing time varies by NYC bakery. Extra merch/giveaways are location-dependent and while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 8 PM until the participating bakery closes. Use Insomnia's official PJ Party locator to choose a NYC bakery and confirm its hours before traveling.
